question: The tone of the passage is best described as:
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The tone of a passage refers to the author’s overall attitude or style of expression. (स्वर / लहजा)
 
• An objective tone means presenting information in a balanced, factual, and unbiased manner. (निष्पक्ष)
 
• The passage discusses both achievements (like villagers earning through ecotourism) and challenges (low funding, land-use issues) in a balanced way.
 
• Thus, the passage is neither negative nor promotional nor sarcastic — it is factual and objective.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3) Objective.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Option 1: Pessimistic (निराशावादी) – A pessimistic tone only highlights negative aspects.

 Example: “Wildlife conservation is failing everywhere.” The passage does not adopt this tone.
 
• Option 2: Promotional (प्रचारात्मक) – A promotional tone exaggerates positives to attract support.

 Example: “Ecotourism always guarantees success.” The passage does not glorify; it also mentions challenges.
 
• Option 4: Sarcastic (व्यंग्यात्मक) – A sarcastic tone mocks or ridicules.

 Example: “Oh, of course, villagers can magically save all wildlife.” The passage does not use ridicule.
